reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so I don't need it in a sachet to go. The named lab and the batch report are nice, but I'm not paying $25 to $30 a month for something I already have in my cupboard.
objection: I already have magnesium at home and it costs me a lot less. The 'to go' part doesn't solve anything for me, and on my budget I can't justify paying more just for the packaging.
would_change_my_mind: A price close to what I pay now, around $14 to $15 for 30 days, with the lab report really matching my batch.
